name: ${modName}
author: WaylandCraft-BE Contributors
description: A full Wayland compositor living inside Minecraft Bedrock. Launch apps, open windows in your world, drag & drop data between them, pin a video player to your HUD. Linux desktop and Android (LeviLaunchroid) ports of EVV1E's WaylandCraft.

platforms.linux: Full compositor: real Wayland apps connect over $WAYLAND_DISPLAY socket
platforms.android: Android bridge: Intent app launcher, capture service frames, Termux wayland apps via TCP bridge

extraInfo.clientSupport: Client-side rendering & input require a LeviLamina client build (LeviLauncher on Windows, LeviLaunchroid on Android)
